name: Archivo Narrow and Lora
summary: A narrow grotesque for headings over a text serif, for briefings with long titles and prose.
description: Archivo Narrow and Lora is a serif OPF font scheme for Latin presentations, using Archivo Narrow for headings with Lora for body text. Archivo Narrow keeps an action title of a full sentence on one or two lines at a large size; Lora gives paragraphs and quotes an even, bookish color. Suits briefings, research readouts and memos turned into slides.
